EVENT REPORT
Case: CTE-164
An event report records an onset window and a provisional symptom description without a linked assessment.
files./workspace/trial/dosing_timeline.txt:
DOSING TIMELINE
A dosing timeline contains a visit reference and an administration interval with one missing timezone marker.
files./workspace/trial/monitoring_note.txt:
MONITORING NOTE
A monitoring note describes a later observation but does not identify its relation to the reported event.
files./workspace/trial/site_message.txt:
SITE MESSAGE
A site message requests continuity information and uses an abbreviated participant reference.
